sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

It sounds like earning our confidence matters to you, yet your proposed quality commitment is weaker than your recorded performance. How will you substantiate a tighter, binding quality commitment with a root-cause and corrective-action report?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 800 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

Hi, we can do the 800 ppm with 0 EUR chargeback, as we are putting extra guys on the line to check the parts. Because of this extra work, we can only go down to 46.50 EUR per unit. 

Our current offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 800 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have to stick to our offer of 46.50 EUR with 0 EUR chargeback. 

So just to be completely clear, our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 800 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We really want to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and build a strong partnership for the future, so we look forward to hearing from you soon.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You reiterate your rejection of chargebacks while attaching your corrective-action report; it seems you want to demonstrate quality responsibility without added financial exposure. We want a lasting partnership grounded in measurable defect reduction and clear accountability for complaint costs. How can the corrective actions in your report underpin a binding quality commitment and a fair allocation of those costs?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 43.31 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 800 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

As to the index change and volume change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We checked your volume forecast and the energy index data, and it helps a bit, so we can drop the price to 46.00 EUR. We still can't do the 150 EUR chargeback, we just can't take on that financial risk right now.

Alternatively, with a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint: €46.00 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so please decide. We are offering a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 800 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

About the quality, those extra guys on the line checking parts will make sure we stick to the 800 ppm. Let's just agree on 45.50 EUR, and if you could pay us faster, that would be great. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. We really want to build a great partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH!

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
